description: This file defines the 'ThemeVariables' class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically within the CorporateBranding plugin. The class encapsulates theme-related color and gradient properties and provides methods to access these properties and create an instance from an array.

classes.name: ThemeVariables
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) that holds theme color and gradient configuration for the OrangeHRM Corporate Branding plugin.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize theme variables with specific color and gradient values.

methods.name: getPrimaryGradientStartColor
methods.description: Returns the start color of the primary gradient.

methods.name: getPrimaryGradientEndColor
methods.description: Returns the end color of the primary gradient.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Static method to create an instance of ThemeVariables from an associative array.
